def fetch_playlists(is_public=None):
    all_pl=[]
    page_index=0
    while True:
        kwargs=dict(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if is_public is not None:
            kwargs['is_public']=is_public
        page=apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(**kwargs)
        print('playlist_library page', page_index, 'is_public', is_public, 'count', len(page))
        if not page:
            break
        all_pl.extend(page)
        page_index+=1
    return all_pl

from math import isnan

def csv_escape(val):
    s = '' if val is None else str(val)
    s = s.replace('"','""')
    if any(c in s for c in [',','\n','\r','"']):
        return '"'+s+'"'
    return s

# Ensure spotify access token and union_song_ids/songs map exist
access_token = spotify_login['access_token']

# Recompute union_song_ids and metadata if missing
if 'song_meta_map' not in globals() or 'union_song_ids' not in globals():
    # fetch song library
    song_lib=[]
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        page=apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not page:
            break
        song_lib.extend(page)
        page_index+=1
    song_meta_map={}
    for s in song_lib:
        sid=s['song_id']
        artists='|'.join([a['name'] for a in s.get('artists',[])])
        song_meta_map[sid]=(s['title'], artists)
    song_lib_ids=set(song_meta_map.keys())

    # album library
    album_song_ids=set()
    page_index=0
    while True:
        page=apis.spotify.show_album_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not page:
            break
        for a in page:
            for sid in a.get('song_ids',[]):
                album_song_ids.add(sid)
        page_index+=1

    # playlists
    pl_song_ids=set()
    for is_public in [True, False]:
        page_index=0
        while True:
            page=apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, is_public=is_public, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
            if not page:
                break
            for pl in page:
                for sid in pl.get('song_ids',[]):
                    pl_song_ids.add(sid)
            page_index+=1

    union_song_ids=sorted(list(set(song_lib_ids) | album_song_ids | pl_song_ids))
else:
    # Ensure all union_song_ids have entries
    missing=[sid for sid in union_song_ids if sid not in song_meta_map]
    for sid in missing:
        s=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
        artists='|'.join([a['name'] for a in s.get('artists',[])])
        song_meta_map[sid]=(s.get('title'), artists)

print('entries_sorted_first', entries[:3])

lines=['Title,Artists']
for title, sid, artists in entries:
